definitions.gloss: to return; to give back; to repay
definitions.explanation: To give something back to its owner or original place, or to respond to an action with a similar action.

examples.japanese: {借|か}りた{本|ほん}を{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: I return the book I borrowed.

examples.japanese: お{金|かね}は{必|かなら}ず{返|かえ}します。
examples.english: I will definitely pay back the money.

examples.japanese: {言葉|ことば}を{返|かえ}すようで{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ないが、それは{違|ちが}うと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I'm sorry to talk back, but I think that's wrong.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
・Pair: {返|かえ}る (intransitive - rare in this meaning)
・Pattern: Xを{返|かえ}す

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本|ほん}を{返|かえ}す (to return a book)
・お{金|かね}を{返|かえ}す (to repay money)
・{言葉|ことば}を{返|かえ}す (to talk back)
・{恩|おん}を{返|かえ}す (to return a favor)

Note: Not to be confused with {帰|かえ}す (to send back home).
